sa: तच्छुत्वा प्राहसन् हंसा ये तत्रासन् समागताः॥ भाषतो बहु काकस्य बलिनः पततां वराः। इदमूचुः स्म चक्राङ्गा वचः काकं विहङ्गमाः॥
en: Hearing the words of the arrogant crow, the swans, that had come there, the foremost of birds gifted with great strength, began to laugh. The swans, who were capable of coursing everywhere at will then, addressed the crow saying.

sa: तं रथं रथिनां श्रेष्ठः कर्णोऽभ्यर्च्य यथाविधि॥ सम्पादितं ब्रह्माविदा पूर्वमेव पुरोधसा। कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं यत्नादुपस्थाय च भास्करम्॥ समीपस्थं मद्रराजमारोह त्वमथाब्रवीत्।
en: Duly worshipping that car which had formerly been sanctified by a priest conversant with Brahma, going round it and worshipping the sun, Karna, the foremost of car-warriors, addressed the king of Madra, standing near him, saying-"get upon the chariot."

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच अयं ते कर्णं सारथ्यं मद्रराजः करिष्यति। कृष्णादभ्यधिको यन्ता देवेशस्येव मातलिः॥
en: Duryodhana said O Karna, this king of Madra, superior even to Krishna, will act as your driver, like Matali, the driver of the king of gods.

sa: इति गायन्ति ये मत्ताः सीधुना शाकलाश्च ये॥ सबालवृद्धाः क्रन्दनन्तस्तेषु धर्मः कथं भवेत्।
en: Thus O Shalya, the young and old inhabitants of Sakala, sing and cry under the influence of liquor. How can there by virtue among such people?

sa: तैरल्पैर्बहवो यूयं क्षयं नीताः प्रहारिणः। शङ्के दैवस्य तत् कर्म पौरुषं येन नाशितम्॥
en: By their small force numerous warriors on your side have been destroyed. I fear it is the work of Destiny by which exertion has been baffled.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच एवं स भगवान् देवः सर्वलोकपितामहः। सारथ्यमकरोत् तत्र ब्रह्मा रुद्रोऽभवद् रथी।॥
en: Duryodhana said Thus that illustrious god, Brahman, that Grandsire of all the words, acted as the charioteer on that occasion; while Rudra acted as the car-warrior.

sa: अयं खलु स संग्रामो यत्र कर्ण मया हतम्। कथयिष्यन्ति भूतानि यावद् भूमिर्धरिष्यति॥
en: But in today's battle I will give no quarter to Karna and all the world will proclaim the fact till as long as it will last.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच सिन्धुराजे हते तात समरे सव्यसाचिना। तथैव भूरिश्रवसि किमासीद् वो मनस्तदा॥
en: Dhritarashtra said What, O Sanjaya, was the state of your mind when the king of Sindhu was slain in battle by Savyasachi and Bhurisrava (by Satyaki)?

sa: न कर्ण देशसामान्यात् सर्वः पापं निषेवते। यादृशाः स्वस्वभावेन देवा अपि न तादृशा॥
en: There is no country, O Karma, where every one is sinful. There are men in many countries who excel even the gods by their good conduct.

sa: बभूव पाण्डवी सेना तव पुत्रस्य तेजसा। पाण्डुसेनां हतां दृष्ट्वा तव पुत्रेण भारत॥
en: The Pandava army became so by virtue of the prowess of your son. Seeing, O Bharata, that the Pandava army was being destroyed by your son.

sa: ते यूयं मे रथं चैव धनुर्वाणं तथैव च। पश्यध्वं यावदद्यैतान् पातयामि महीतले॥
en: Do you all now behold my car, the bow and arrow, as also how I cast down today these antagonists upon the surface of the earth.

sa: अभ्यधावत् कुरुपति तव पुत्रं जिघांसया। तावुभौ युधि कौरव्यो समीयतुररिंदमौ॥ स्वार्थहेतोः पराक्रान्तौ दुर्योधनयुधिष्ठिरौ।
en: Duryodhana, the warrior of Kuru clan and Yudhishthira both suppressor to enemy attacked furiously on each other with fantastic exhibition of valour for their respective interests.

sa: स विद्ध्वा समरे द्रोणं सिंहनादममुञ्चत। तं वै न ममृषे द्रोणः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः॥
en: Thus wounding Drona in battle he sent up his war-cry. But Drona that foremost of all wielders of weapons did not brook that war-cry of his.

sa: ततस्तु त्वरितो भीमः क्राथं निन्ये यमक्षयम्॥ नाराचेन सुतीक्ष्णेन स हतो न्यपतद् भुवि।
en: Then in a moment Bhima dispatched Kratha to the abode of Yama with a long keen arrow. Deprived of life that prince fell down on earth.

sa: यस्य वीर्यं समाश्रित्य शमं याचन्तमच्युतम्। तृणवत् तमहं मन्ये स कर्णो निर्जितो युधि॥
en: Relying upon whose prowess 1 regarded that undeteriorating one (i.e., Krishna) who sued for peace, (something) like a straw, that Karna has been defeated in battle.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अतितीव्राणि दुःखानि दुःसहानि बहूनि च। त्वतोऽहं संजयश्रौषं पुत्राणां चैव संत्रयम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, I have heard from you of great and intolerable grief's of fierce character as well as of the destruction of my sons.

sa: पुनः सज्यं कृतं चापं तदप्यस्य द्विधाच्छिनत्। विरथस्योद्यतं खङ्गं शरेणास्य द्विधाकरोत्॥ अथैनं निशितैर्बाणैश्चतुर्भिर्भरतर्षभ।
en: (The Rakshasa) took up another stringed bow again but (Arjuna) cut it off in two fragments. Then O foremost of the Bharatas, with four sharpened arrows.

sa: स विद्धवा सात्यकिं षष्ट्या तथा षोडशभिः शरैः। नाकम्पय स्थितं युद्धे मैनाकमिव पर्वतम्॥
en: Having pierced Satyaki first with sixty shafts and next with sixteen, he could not make him tremble who was fighting steadily like the immovable Mainaka mountain.

sa: सर्वतो भरतश्रेष्ठ विसृजन् सायकान् बहून्। पर्जन्य इव घोषेण नादयन् वै दिशो दश॥
en: And filled the ten quarters with the clatter of his car-wheels, that resembled the rumble or rain clouds. Beholding that Kaurava hero advance upon him Satyaki.

sa: चतुर्भिर्वाजिनस्तस्य सारथिं च त्रिभिः शरैः। सात्यकिं च शतेनाजौ विद्ध्वा नादं मुमोच सः॥
en: Then piercing Satyaki himself with a set of hundred arrows, he uttered his war-cry. Thereupon O mighty monarch, that descendant of Madhu's race, being worked up

sa: अर्जुन उवाच अद्य तं पापकर्माण सानुबन्धं रणे शरैः। नयाम्यन्तं समासाद्य राधेयं बलगर्वितम्॥
en: Arjuna said Getting hold of that sinful son of Radha, who vaunts of his prowess, I shall in today's battle slay him along with his allies.

sa: प्रहरस्व च मे वीर पश्यामस्तव पौरुषम्। कर्म कृत्वा रणे शूर ततः कस्थितुमर्हसि॥
en: 'O brave warrior, strike me; we will behold your manliness. O hero, first having achieved some deed in the battle, then it behoves you to speak.

sa: बृहत्क्षत्रेण तत् ततोऽस्रे निहते ब्राह्मे बृहत्क्षवस्तु भारत। विव्याध ब्राह्मणं षष्ट्या स्वर्णपुजैः शिलाशितैः॥
en: Then O Bharata, when the Brahma weapon had been baffled, Vrihadkshatra pierced the Brahmana with sixty shafts, whetted on stones and furnished with wings of gold.

sa: कर्ण उवाच आचार्य मा विगर्हस्व शक्तयासौ युध्यते द्विजः। यथाबलं यथोत्साहं त्यक्त्वा जीवितमात्मनः॥
en: Karna said Do not blame the preceptor. (For) the twiceborn one is fighting to the best of his prowess and energy and heedless of his life.

sa: पाणौ पृषत्का निशिता ममैव धनुश्च सज्यं विततं सबाणम्॥ पादौ च मे सरथौ सध्वजौ च न मादृशं युद्धगतं जयन्ति।
en: In my palms there are the signs of sharp swords and stringed bows and arrows and in my soles and the marks of cars and ensigns. That is why a man like me can never be defeated in battle.

sa: समास्तु शाश्वतीर्हन्याद् यो मां हन्याद्वि संयुगे। किं वृथोक्तेन बहुना कर्मणा तत् समाचर॥
en: He that will slay me in battle will ever be victorious. What is the use of vain boasts. Achieve in deeds what you say in words.

sa: तथा तु दृष्ट्वा योधास्ते प्रहृष्टौ कृष्णपाण्डवौ। हतो राजा हतो राजेत्यूचिरे च भयार्दिताः॥
en: Then your warriors beholding Krishna and Pandu's son filled with joy, out of fear, began to exclaim saying "the king is slain, the king is slain."

sa: उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ राजेन्द्र शाधि किं करवाणि ते। न ह्यसाध्यमकार्य वा विद्यते मम मानद॥
en: Arise, arise, O foremost of king! Command me what act of yours shall I do? O giver of honours, there is nothing which I cannot accomplish.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो राजानमभ्येत्य धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। ववन्दे स प्रहृष्टात्मा हते पार्थेन सैन्धवे॥
en: Sanjaya said The king of Sindhu being slain by Partha, (Krishna) then approached king Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma and worshipped him with a merry heart.

sa: चिराभिलषितं काममहं प्राप्स्यामि संयुगे। न हि मे मोक्ष्यसे जीवन् यदि नोत्सृजसे रणम्॥
en: Today, I shall realise in battle my longcherish I hope; you shall not escape me alive if indeed you do not fly away from the battle.

sa: उवाच सर्वांश्च पदातिसङ्घान् दुर्योधनः पार्थिव सान्त्वपूर्वम्। उत्सृज्य सर्वे परमायुधानि गृह्णीत हस्तैललितान् प्रदीपान्॥
en: (And) consoling all the foot-soldiers and also the lords of the earth, Duryodhana said to them "leaving aside your great weapons, take in hand blazing lamps.”

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा निहतं शूरं भ्राता तस्य महारथः। सज्यमन्यद् धनुः कृत्वा शैनेयः पर्यवारयत्॥
en: Having seen that hero slain, his brother, that mighty car-warrior (Vinda), after having stretched out the string of another bow, restrained the course of Shini's grandson.

sa: भ्रातृत्वं दर्शितं पूर्व घृणी चापि स सूतजः। कथं भीमेन युयुधे कुन्त्या वाक्यमनुस्मरन्॥
en: Knowing his brotherhood towards the Pandavas and possessing a compassionate temperament and remembering the words of Kunti, how could the son of Şuta fight with Bhimasena?

sa: शुशुभे केतुना तेन राजतेन जयद्रथः॥ यथा देवासुरे युद्धे पुरा पूषा स्म शोभते।
en: With that device on his standard, Jayadratha appeared as beautiful. As Pusha in the days of yore, in the battle between the celestials and the Asuras.

sa: यो जात: कुण्डलाभ्यां च कवचेन सहैव च। तं सूतपुत्रं समरे भीमः कथमयोधयत्॥
en: How did Bhima then fight with that son of Suta who was born with a pair of (natural) earrings and covered in a coat of mail.

sa: न ह्यहत्वा रणे शत्रु सोमदत्तं महाबलम्। निवर्तिध्ये रणात् सूत सत्यमेतद् वचो मम॥
en: O charioteer, I will not return from battle today without killing my enemy-the vilest of the Kurus, the son of Valhika. These my words are true.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवः पाण्डवानां महारथः। हता द्रोणेन विक्रम्य यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥
en: These and several other mighty car-warriors among the Pandavas were slain by Drona displaying their prowess in battle. These are all that you had asked me.

sa: तदपास्य धनुश्छिन्नं धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः। अथान्यद् धनुरादाय शरांश्चासीविषोपमान्॥ कर्णं विव्याध सप्तत्या शरैः संनतपर्वभिः।
en: Then throwing off his broken bow the great car-warrior Dhrishtadyumna took up a fresh one and shafts resembling venomous snakes and struck Karna with seventy arrows.

sa: पाण्डवास्तु जयं लब्ध्वा हृष्टा ह्यासन् विशाम्पते। अरिक्षयं च संग्रामे तेन ते सुखमाप्नुवन्॥
en: The Pandavas, having obtained victory were transported with joy, O ruler of men; and great was their happiness at the destruction of their foes in battle.

sa: हस्तिकक्ष्यां रणे पश्य चरन्तीं तत्र तत्र ह। व्यस्यं सूतपुत्रस्य केतुं केतुमतां वर॥
en: O foremost of those leading standards, see the standard the bearing the emblem of an elephant of charioteer's son is moving about all over (the field).

sa: मयि जीवति कौरव्य विषादं मा कृथाः क्वचित्। अहं जेष्यामि समरे सहितान् सर्वपाण्डवान्॥
en: O lord of the Kauravas, since I am alive you need not give way to sorrow. I will, in battle, destroy all the Pandavas joined together.

sa: गजो वाजी नरो वापि यो न पार्थशराहतः॥ रजसा तमसा चैव योधाः संछन्नचक्षुषः।
en: A single elephant or horses of men that was not struck with the arrows of Partha. The vision of warriors were blinded with dust and darkness.

sa: ये मां युद्धेऽभियोत्स्यन्ति तान् हनिष्यामि भारत॥ न हि ते वीर मोक्ष्यन्ते मद्वाह्वन्तरमागताः।
en: O Bharata, I will destroy all those that will confront me in battle. O hero, afflicted with the prowess of my arms no one shall escape.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच आचार्य: पाण्डुपुत्रान् वै पुत्रवत् परिरक्षति। त्वमप्युपेक्षां कुरुषे तेषु नित्यं द्विजोत्तम॥
en: Duryodhana said The protector protects the sons of Pandu as if they were his own children. You also never manage in right earnest with my enemies.

sa: रथनागाश्वकलिलं पत्तिध्वद समाकुलम्। बभूव पुरुषव्याघ्र सैन्यमद्भुतदर्शनम्॥
en: The hosts, abounding in cars, elephants, the cavalry and infantry, looked exceedingly wonderful.

sa: दिशः खं च सैन्यं च समावृण्वन् महाहवे। मुहूर्ताद् भास्करस्येव लोके राजन् गभस्तयः॥
en: Those arrows, O king, like the rays of the Sun, in that terrible battle, covered all the quarters of heaven, the sky and the Pandava soldiers.

sa: इत्युक्तवा वचनं राजञ्जयं प्राप्य वृकोदरः। पुनराह महाराज स्मयंस्तौ केशवार्जुनौ॥ असृग्दिग्धो विस्त्रवल्लोहितास्यः क्रुद्धोऽत्यर्थ भीमसेनस्तरस्वी। दुःशासने यद् रणे संश्रुतं मे तद् वै सत्यं कृतमोह वीरौ॥
en: Thus speaking, O monarch, the shorttempered Bhimasena, who was all bleeding and was very red in the face and highly wrathful Vrikodara, after gaining victory, addressed both Keshava and Arjuna, spoke these words-"You witness, O you brave warriors, that in battle I have this day redeemed by pledge regarding Dushasana,

sa: युधामन्युः कृपं विद्ध्वा धनुरस्याशु चिच्छिदे। अथान्यद् धनुरादाय कृपः शस्त्रभृतां वरः॥ युधामन्योर्ध्वजं सूतं छत्रं चापातयत् क्षितौ। ततोऽपायाद् रथेनैव युधामन्युर्महारथः॥
en: Having struck Kripa Yudhamanyu soon cut-off his bow. But Kripa, the foremost of the wielders of arms, taking up another bow struck down on earth Yudhamanyu's standard, charioteer and umbrella. the great car-warrior Yudhamanyu fled away on his car.

sa: अगाधबुद्धिर्गाङ्गेयः क्षितौ सुरगुरोः समः। त्याजितः समरे प्राणांस्तस्माद् युद्धं हि निष्ठुरम्॥ तान् निहत्य महाबाहू राधेयस्यैव पश्यतः। सिंहनादरवं घोरमसृजत् पाण्डुनन्दनः॥
en: That son of Pandu uttered a dreadful warcry. The shout of that hero, then O Bharata, carried to the very virtuous king Yudhishthira as if the intelligence of his victory. Hearing that loud cry of that fierce bowman Bhimasena.

sa: राक्षसो रावणो मूल् वीर्योद्रेकेण बाधते। ऋषयश्च ततस्तेन गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा॥ क्रीडन्तो नन्दनवने रौद्रेण विनिपातिताः।
en: And by him bereft of the sense of right and wrong, have saints and Gandharvas and Apsaras sporting in the groves of Nandana, been wantonly slain.

sa: भर्तुः किल परित्यागो नृशंसः केवलं स्त्रियाः। स भवत्या न कर्तव्यो मनसापि विगर्हितः॥
en: There is nothing more cruel for women than the forsaking of their husband; it does not behove you therefore, to think even of this opprobrious action.

sa: तत्समुत्थेन शोकेन वाष्पोपहतचेतनम्॥ तं शोचमानं काकुत्स्थं नित्यं शोकपरायणम्। तुल्यदुःखोऽब्रवीद् भ्राता लक्ष्मणोऽनुनयं वचः॥
en: His younger brother Laksmana, equally aggrieved, spoke to Kākutstha, thus bewailing being exercised with grief and almost beside himself with sorrow, consequent upon Sita's bereavement, saying.

sa: त्वं हि शूरश्च बलवान् हन्या एतान् न संशयः। स्वयं निहन्तुमिच्छामि सर्वानेव निशाचरान्॥
en: You are both strong and a hero: You can, without doubt, slay these Rākşasas. But I wish to slay all these rangers of the night myself.

sa: मयापि व्यसनं प्राप्तं भार्याविरहजं महत्। नाहमेवं हि शोचामि धैर्ये न च परित्यजे॥
en: I also have experienced mighty disaster arising out of separation from my wife; but I do not weep in this wise,-nor do I forsake my fortitude.

sa: इह भूम्यां मलं दत्त्वा देवाः कारूषमेव च॥ शरीरजं महेन्द्रस्य ततो हर्ष प्रपेदिरे।
en: And the deities, having renounced here the filth that had clung to the person of the mighty Indra, as well as his hunger, attained exceeding delight.

sa: यदि ताल त्वया दृष्टा पक्वतालोपमस्तनी। कथयस्व वरारोहां कारुण्यं यदि ते मयि ॥
en: O Tāla, if you have any pity on me do you tell me whether you have beheld that fair damsel having breast resembling ripe Tāla fruits.

sa: कथं नरवर श्रेष्ठ पुत्रौ तौ सह सीतया। दुःखितौ सुखसंवृद्धौ वने दुःखं सहिष्यतः॥
en: Why then have you forsaken those foremost of men along with Sītā? Brought up in happiness, and now brought to misery, how can they bear it?

sa: कैलासं पर्वतं गत्वा विजित्य नरवाहनम्॥ विमानं पुष्पकं तस्य कामगं वै जहार यः।
en: Who, going to Kailasa, and defeating him having for his vehicle a human being, had carried of the car Puspaka coursing at every where at will;

sa: तदिदं ह्यन्यथाभूतं व्यवदीर्णं मनो मम। पितरं यो न पश्यामि नित्यं प्रियहिते रतम्॥
en: But it has fallen out otherwise. That I do not behold my father ever engaged in the dear welfare (of his subjects) cleaves my heart mother.

sa: न च सर्पन्ति सत्त्वानि व्याला न प्रचरन्ति च। रामशोकाभिभूतं त निष्कूजमिव तद्वनम्॥
en: Creatures do not move and beasts of prey cease to range about; and the forest appears to be dumb, stupefied by grief on account of Rāma.

sa: उपभुक्तं यथा वासः स्रजो वा मृदिता यथा। एवं राज्यात् परिभ्रष्टः समर्थोऽपि निरर्थकः॥
en: Like a cloth that has been worn, like a garland that has been trodden, a king that had been dethroned, although able, is of no consequence.

sa: शक्तो ह्येष मया गुप्तो दिव्येन स्वेन तेजसा ॥ राक्षसा ये विकारस्तेषामपि विनाशने। श्रेयश्चास्मै प्रदास्यामि बहुरूपं न संशयः॥ त्रयाणामपि लोकानां येन ख्यातिं गमिष्यति। न च तौ राममासाद्य शक्तौ स्थातुं कथंचन॥ न च तौ राघवादन्यो हन्तुमुत्सहते पुमान्। वीर्योत्सितौ हि तौ पापौ कालपाशवशं गतौ॥ रामस्य राजशार्दूल न पर्याप्तो महात्मनः।
en: By virtue of his own divine energy, he, being protected by me, is capable of even destroying those Rākşasas disturbing the ceremony. And I will, without doubt, confer upon him manifold blessings, by means of which he will secure the golden opinions of the three worlds. And encountering Rāma, they will by no means be able to stand him, nor is there any other who dares to slay them. And puffed up with energy, they have become ensnared at the hands of Käla, (Yama, the god of death.) and, O tiger of a monarch, they are no match for Rāma.

sa: इति हृदयसुखं निशम्य वाक्यं श्रुतिसुखमात्मवता विनीतमुक्तम्। प्रथितगुणयशा गुणैर्विशिष्टः परमऋषिः परमं जगाम हर्षम्॥
en: Hearing this soul-soothing, ear-charming, and free-humble speech that was uttered, the illustrious prime of ascetics crowned with virtues, and furnished with all perfections, experienced exceeding delight.

sa: निर्यासरसमूलानां चन्दनानां सहस्रशः। वनानि पश्यन् सौम्यानि घ्राणतृप्तिकराणि च ॥ अगुरूणां च मुख्यानां वनान्युपवनानि च। तक्कोलानां च जात्यानां फलानां च सुगन्धिनाम्।।२२। पुष्पाणि च तमालस्य गुल्मानि मरिचस्य च। मुक्तानां च समूहानि शुष्यमाणानि तीरतः॥ शैलानि प्रवरांश्चैव प्रवालनिचयांस्तथा। काञ्चनानि च शृङ्गाणि राजतानि तथैव च॥ प्रस्रवाणि मनोज्ञानि प्रसन्नान्यद्भुतानि च। धनधान्योपपन्नानि स्त्रीरत्नैरावृतानि च॥ हस्त्यश्वरथगाढानि नगराणि विलोकयन्। तं समं सर्वतः स्निग्धं मृदुसंस्पर्शमारुतम्॥ अनूपे सिन्धुराजस्
en: And surveying by thousands woods of sandal exuding gum at their roots*, and of choice aguru, grateful to the sense of smell; and woods and groves of excellent and odorous takkola fruits; blossoms of the Tamāla, and thickets of black pepper; heaps of pearls drying on the shore; rocks; the best corals in masses, summits of gold and silver;+ charming pellucid rills at places; and cities filled with corn and wealth, abounding in gems of women, and thronged with horses, elephants and cars—Rāvana on the shore of the ocean beheld around a level and soft scene, resembling heaven itself—where breezes of delicate feel kept breathing. *Niryāsarasamūlānām, gen, (sandal), which forms the principal ingredient in perfumes, containing odorous gums. Another reading is: heaps of conch. Some text read Sailam

sa: त्वद्विधः कामवृत्तो हि दुःशीलः पापमन्त्रितः। आत्मानं स्वजनं राष्ट्रं स राजा हन्ति दुर्मतिः॥
en: The sovereign who is wicked, whimsical and of evil intent like you, bring about his own destruction as well as that of his kingdom and relatives.

sa: मम कायात् प्रसूतौ हि दुःखितौ भारपीडितौ। यौ दृष्ट्वा परितप्येऽहं नास्ति पुत्रसमः प्रियः॥
en: Seeing those that have been born of my body, cast down and in trouble, I grieve: there is none that is dear like to a son.

sa: मृते मयि गते रामे वनं पुरुषपुङ्गवे। सेदानीं विधवा राज्यं सपुत्रा कारयिष्यसि ॥
en: When I am dead, and when that foremost of men has gone to the forest, do you, a widow, rule the kingdom along with your son.

sa: नहि ते निष्ठुरं वाच्यो भरतो नाप्रियं वचः। अहं ह्यप्रियमुक्तः स्यां भरतस्याप्रिये कृते॥
en: Certainly you ought not to say cruel or unpleasant words in relation to Bharata, if wrong be done to Bharata, I shall consider myself as wornged.

sa: क्षमा यस्मिंस्तपस्त्यागः सत्यं धर्मः कृतज्ञता। अप्यहिंसा च भूतानां तमृते का गतिर्मम ॥
en: And what stay have I save him in whom abide forgiveness, and asceticism and renunciation, and verity, and righteousness, and gratitude, and harmlessness towards all creatures.

sa: ब्राह्मणोऽसीति पूज्यो मे विश्वामित्रकृतेन च। तस्माच्छक्को न ते राम मोक्तुं प्राणहरं शरम्॥
en: You are a Brāhmana and through Viśvāmitra, art worthy of my homage. Therefore it is, o Rāma, that I can not let go this life-destroying shaft.

sa: तां तु सीतामहं मन्ये रामस्य परिकीर्तनात्। श्रूयतां मे कथयतो निलयं तस्य रक्षसः॥
en: From your relation of Rāma, I conclude that she must be Sītā. Now listen to me as I tell you about the abode of that Rākşasa.

sa: मूलं ह्येष मनुष्याणां धर्मसारो महाद्युतिः। पुष्पं फलं च पत्रं च शाखाश्चास्येतरे जनाः॥
en: Surely this highly effulgent one with virtue for his chief good, is the root of humanity, and the latter represents its flowers, fruits, foliage, and boughs.

sa: तौ दत्तौ च वरौ देव निक्षेपौ मृगयाम्यहम्। तवैव पृथिवीपाल सकाशे रघुनन्दन॥ तत् प्रतिश्रुत्य धर्मेण न चेद् दास्यसि मे वरम्। अद्यैव हि प्रहास्यामि जीवितं त्वद्विमानिता॥
en: Entrusting the boons then with you, dc I now, O descendant of the Raghus, ask for them (at your hands), O lord of the earth. If having religiously promised to that effect, you did not confer the boon, this very day, will I, coming by this disgrace from you, renounce my life.

sa: अभिनन्द्य समापृच्छय समाधाय च राघवम्। स जगामाश्रमं त्यक्त्वा कुलैः कुलपतिः सह ॥
en: Then having paid homage to Rāma, and spoken to him and encouraged Rāghava, the patriach ascetic renouncing the asylum, went away along with his own people.

sa: प्रत्यक्षं सप्त ते ताला मया बाणेन दारिताः॥ तेनावेहि बलेनाद्य वालिनं निहतं रणे।
en: You didst behold seven Talas riven by a single shaft of mine and do you therefore consider Vāli destroyed to-day by my prowess in the conflict.

sa: सुराघटसहस्रेण मांसभूतौदनेन च। यक्ष्ये त्वां प्रीयतां देवि पुरीं पुनरुपागता॥ यानि त्वत्तीरवासीनि दैवतानि च सन्ति हि। तानि सर्वाणि यक्ष्यामि तीर्थान्यायतनानि च॥ पुनरेव महाबाहुर्मया भ्रात्रा च संगतः। अयोध्यां वनवासात् तु प्रविशत्वनघोऽनघे॥
en: O worshipful one, I will worship you on Rāma having returned to the city. And I will worship all the gods that dwell on your banks, as well as the holy spots and fanes, as soon as, O sinless one, that mighty-armed one without sin will, coming back from his abode in the forest, enter Ayodhyā in company with his brother and myself.

sa: यदा च रामः पृथिवीमवाप्स्यते प्रभूतरत्नाकरशैलसंयुताम्। तदा गमिष्यस्यशुभं पराभवं सहैव दीना भरतेन भामिनि॥
en: When Rāma will obtain the earth furnished witr many oceans and mountains, then, O proud dame, you rendered forlorn, will along with Bharata, sustain sorry discomfiture.

sa: युध्यस्व यदि शूरोऽसि मुहूर्तं तिष्ठ रावण। शयिष्यसे हतो भूमौ यथा पूर्वं खरस्तथा॥
en: If you are a hero do you fight. Or do you wait for a moment, O Rāvana, you shall also embrace the earth like to Khara.

sa: भगीरथात् ककुत्स्थश्च काकुत्स्था येन तु स्मृताः। ककुत्स्थस्य तु पुत्रोऽभूद् रघुर्येन तु राघवाः॥
en: From Bhagiratha sprang Kakutstha; from whom the Kākutsthas came to be well known. Kakutstha had Raghu for his son; after whom have been named the Rāghavas.

sa: स राजा सगरो नाम यः समुद्रमखानयत्। इष्टा पर्वणि वेगेन त्रासयान इमाः प्रजाः॥
en: The name of that king is Sagara, who having been initiated in a sacrifice excavated the ocean, frightening the people with the vehemence of his operations.

sa: तप्यमानं तदा रामं सीताहरणकर्शितम्। लोकानामभवे युक्तं सांवर्तकमिवानलम्॥ वीक्षमाणं धनुः सज्यं निःश्वसन्तं पुनः पुनः। दग्धुकामं जगत् सर्वं युगान्ते च यथा हरम्॥ अदृष्टपूर्वं संक्रुद्धं दृष्ट्वा रामं स लक्ष्मणः। अब्रवीत् प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं मुखेन परिशुष्यता॥
en: Rāma highly aggrieved on account of Sīta's being carried away, addressing himself to destroy the world like to the fire of dissolution and casting his look, sighing again and again, upon the stringed bow like to Mahadeva desirous of burning down the whole world at the time of dissolution, Laksmana, having his countenance dried up, beholding his rage not seen before, began with folded hands.

sa: किं कार्यं कस्य वा हेतोः कान्ताराणि प्रपद्यथ॥ कथं चेदं वनं दुर्गं युष्माभिरुपलक्षितम्।
en: What is your errand? And why is it that you have arrived at these lone woods? And how have you managed to see this inaccessible forest?

sa: नराधिपकुले जाता महिषी त्वं महीपतेः। उग्रत्वं राजधर्माणां कथं देवि न बुध्यसे ॥
en: Born in a race of king you are the queen of this lord of earth. Why did not you then realise the sternness of royal morality.

sa: आश्रमं तस्य धर्मज्ञ धार्मिकस्य महात्मनः। आचक्ष्व कतमो मार्गः कियानिति च शंस मे॥
en: And tell me, O you cognizant of morality, how far is it to that high-souled righteous one's asylm, and by what way (shall I reach there)?

sa: अर्थधर्मपरा ये ये तांस्ताशोचामि नेतरान्। ते हि दुःखमिह प्राप्य विनाशं प्रेत्य लेभिरे॥
en: Those that disregarding interest are devoted to virtue, do I mourn, and not others; for having suffered misery here, they in the end meet with extinction.

sa: नह्येषा बुद्धिरास्थेया हनूमन्नङ्गदं प्रति। पिता हि बन्धुः पुत्रस्य न माता हरिसत्तम ॥
en: O Hanumān, do you not consider that I shall confer this kingdom upon Angada-0 best of monkeys, father is son's friend (in this respect) not mother.

sa: यावन्न रामं द्रक्ष्यामि लक्ष्मणं वा महाबलम्। वैदेहीं वा महाभागां न मे शान्तिर्भविष्यति॥
en: So long as I do not see Răma, or the mighty Lakṣmaṇa, or the highly exalted daughter of Videha, I shall not attain peace of mind.

sa: यदिदं राज्यतन्त्रं मे त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्। जीवितं च विशालाक्षि त्वं मे प्राणैर्गरीयसी॥
en: If such is my sovereignty, all this is established in you, O large-eyed lady, as well as my life. You are dearer to me than life.

sa: अयं स कालः सम्प्राप्तः प्रियो यस्ते प्रियंवद। अलंकृत इवाभाति येन संवत्सरः शुभः॥
en: O sweet-speeched one, now is come that season which you have ever held dear; and as if decorated by which comes on the entire auspicious year.

sa: मयि तत्रोपविष्टे तु भीष्मे च कुरुसत्तमे। उपायो यो भवेद् दृष्टस्तं ब्रूयाः सहसौबलः॥
en: When I shall remain seated (tomorrow) with that foremost of the Kurus, you will then with Subala's son propose the pretext you may have fixed upon.

sa: स्वप्ने तानि न दृश्यन्ते जाग्रतो वा युधिष्ठिर। कितवा यानि दीव्यन्तः प्रलपन्त्युत्कटा इव।॥
en: O Yudhisthira, know, gamesters in the excitement of the play utter such raving as they would never do in their waking moments or in their dreams.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः स कौन्तेयो लोमशेन महर्षिणा। पप्रच्छानन्तरं भूयः सोमकं प्रति भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of Bharata, having been thus addressed by the great Rishi Lomasha, the son of Kunti (Yudhishthira) asked other questions about Somaka.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्ताश्च ते पार्था यमौ च पुरुषर्षभौ। द्रौपद्या सहिताः सर्वे नभश्चक्रुर्जनार्दनम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Having been thus addressed, the sons of Pritha and those two foremost of men, the twins, with Draupadi, all bowed down to Janardana (Krishna).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कर्णस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा दुर्योधनस्ततः। हृष्टो भूत्वा पुनर्दीन इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard the words of Karna, the king Duryodhana became greatly delighted. But soon again the became melancholy and he then thus spoke.

sa: ईश्वरं चापि भूतानांधातारं मा च वै क्षिप। शिक्षस्वैनं नमस्वैनं मा तेऽभूद् बुद्धिरीदृशी॥
en: Do not speak ill of God who is the lord of all creatures; learn to know him; bow to him; let not your understanding be such.

sa: व्रीडा चात्र न कर्तव्या साहसं यदिदं कृतम्। दृष्टश्चापि सुरैः पूर्वं विनाशो यक्षरक्षसाम्॥
en: Nor you ought to be ashamed at his act of rashness. The destruction of the Yakshas and the Rakshasas had been fore ordained by the celestials.

sa: आरुरोह रथं शौरेः सत्यभामाथ भाविनी। स्मयित्वा तु यदुश्रेष्ठो द्रौपदी परिसान्त्व्य च। उपावर्त्य ततः शीघैर्हयैः : प्रायात् पुरं स्वकम्॥
en: The beautiful Satyabhama then ascended the chariot of Krishna. The chief of the Yudus (Krishna) comforted Draupadi with a smile; and then asking the Pandavas to return to their house), he started for his own city with swift horses.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो भीष्मः शान्तनवो बुद्ध्याद् निश्चित्य वीर्यवान्। अमन्यत तदा कृष्णमहणीयतमं भुवि॥
en: Vaishampayana said O Descendant of Bharata, the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, settled it by his great intelligence that Krishna was the foremost of all on earth.

sa: सत्येनधर्मेण यथार्हवृत्त्या ह्रिया तथा सर्वभूतान्यतीत्य। यशश्च तेजश्च तवापि दीप्तं विभावसो स्करस्येव पार्थ॥
en: O son of Pritha, you have excelled all men in truth, piety, decorum and modesty; your fame and energy are brilliant as fire or the sun.

sa: ततो बहुतिथे काले लोपामुद्रां विशाम्पते। तपसा द्योतितां स्नातां ददर्श भगवानृषिः॥ स तस्याः परिचारेण शौचेन च दमेन च। श्रिया रूपेण च प्रीतो मैथुनायाजुहाव ताम्॥
en: After a long time, O king, the illustrious Rishi one day saw Lopamudra, blazing in ascetic splendour, coming after a bath in her season. Being pleased with her service, with her purity, with her self-control, with her grace and beauty, he summoned her for the purpose of living with her.

sa: ऋषिभिः क्रतवः प्रोक्ता देवेष्विह यथाक्रमम्। फलं चैव यथातथ्यं प्रेत्य चेह च सर्वशः॥
en: The Rishis have told in due order the sacrifices and also their fruits to be obtained here (in this birth) and hereafter (in the next birth).

sa: उत्तिष्ठ देहि मे मार्ग पश्य चाद्य पौरुषम्। मच्छासनमकुर्वाणं त्वां वा नेष्ये यमक्षयम्॥
en: Arise therefore, give me way or witness my prowess today. If you fail to do what I say, I send you to the abode of Yama.

sa: सहस्रं तेऽस्तु पुत्राणां शतं वा दशसम्मितम्। दश वा शततुल्याः स्युरेको वापि सहस्रजित्॥
en: Do you desire to have one thousand sons or one hundred sons, each equal to one hundred or only one such who can conquer one thousand.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो देवं महादेवं गिरिशं शूलपाणिनम्। ददर्श फाल्गुनस्तत्र सह देव्या महाद्युतिम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Thereupon Falguni (Arjuna) saw that greatly effulgent deity, the great god, the dweller of the mountain, the wielder of the Pinaka, with his wife.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततश्चेदिपते: श्रुत्वा भीष्मः स कटुकं वचः। उवाचेदं वचो राजश्चेदिराजस्य शृण्वतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said O king, having heard these rude and harsh words of the Chedi king, Bhishma spoke thus in the hearing of the king of Chedi.

sa: तत: स्विष्टं भवेदाज्यं स्विष्टकृत् परमस्तु सः। कन्या सा रोहिणी नाम हिरण्यकशिपोः सुता॥
en: The daughter of Manu is called Svistakrit, for by offering oblations to her, one acquires great merit. That damsel named Rohini was the 'aughter of Hiranyakashipu;

sa: अहं बकस्य वै भ्राता किसर इति विश्रुतः। वनेऽस्मिन् काम्यके शून्ये निवसामि गतज्वरः॥
en: I am the brother of Baka and I am known by the name of Kirmira. I live in this uninhabited Kamyaka forest in comfort and ease.

sa: आसीत् पुरषशार्दूल दृष्टवा पार्थं तथागतम्। आह मां तत्र देवेशो गच्छ पाण्डुसुतान् प्रति॥
en: On seeing Partha sitting in that way. O foremost of men, then the chief of the celestials said to me, “Go to the sons of Pandu."

sa: अग्निर्ददातु मे तेजो वायुः प्राणं ददातु मे। पृथिवी बलमादध्याच्छिवं चापो दिशन्तु मे॥
en: O Agni, let yourself grant me energy and let Vayu grant me life. Let earth grant me nourishment and strength, and let water grant me prosperity.

sa: लोमश उवाच इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले जातः सगरो नाम पार्थिवः। रूपसत्त्वबलोपेतः स चापुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Lomasha said: In the race of the Ikshvaku there was born a king, named Sagara, possessing beauty of person and prowess. That mighty king was son-less.

sa: शूद्रोः यथेप्सितान् कामान् ब्राह्मणः पारगः पठन्। यश्चेदं शृणुयान्नित्यं तीर्थपुण्यं नरः शुचिः॥ जाती: स स्मरते बह्वी कपृष्ठे च मोदते। गम्यान्यपि च तीर्थानि कीर्तितान्यगमानि च॥
en: The Shudra cbtains all his desires and the Brahmana crosses the ocean (of world). The man who daily hears it with purity. Becomes abic to remember the incidents of his former births and rejoices in heaven. Some of the Tirthas that have been narrated here are accessible and some inaccessible.

sa: स तं दृष्ट्वैव वरदं पत्नीभ्यां सहितो नृपः। प्रणिपत्य महाबाहुः पुत्रार्थे समयाचत॥ तं प्रीतिमान् हरः प्राह सभार्यं नृपसत्तमम्। यस्मिन् वृतो मुहूर्तेऽहं त्वयेह नृपते वरम्॥
en: As soon as he saw that giver of boons, that mighty-armed king bowed to him along with his two wives and prayed for a son. Hara (Shiva) being pleased said to that best of kings with his wives. “O king, considering the moment in which you have asked the boon.

sa: सप्तगङ्गे त्रिगङ्गे च शक्रावर्ते च तर्पयन्। देवान् पितॄश्च विधिवत् पुण्ये लोके महीयते॥
en: Offering oblations according to the ordinance to the Pitris and the celestials at Saptaganga, Triganga and Shakravarta, one becomes adored in the regions of the virtuous.

sa: जामदग्न्येन रामेण यथा वृद्धौ सुपूजितौ। तथा त्वया कृतं सर्वं तद्विशिष्टं च पुत्रक॥
en: O son, as the son of Jamadagni, Rama tried to serve his old parents, so have you done to please us, nay you have done more.

sa: समधीतं मया ब्रह्म व्रतानि चरितानि च। कथं च रैभ्यः शक्तो मामधीयानं तपस्विनम्॥
en: “I have obtained the knowledge of all the Vedas, I have also observed vows. How came it then that Raivya killed me who am an ascetic!

sa: अमर्षण: स्वाः प्रकृतीरभिभूयः परं स्थितः। क्लेशान् मुमुक्षुः परजान् स वै पुरुष उच्यते॥
en: He is called a (true) man who lives after having vanquished his enemy in order to liberate his own subjects from the tyranny of that enemy.

sa: ततोऽस्मि पतितो भूमौ न च मामजहात् स्मृतिः। स्मार्तमस्ति पुराणं मे यथैवाधिगतं तथा।॥
en: I then fell down to the earth, but my memory did not fail me. Therefore do I still remember the past, however ancient it might be.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच गते तु विदुरे राजन्नाश्रमं पाण्डवान् प्रति! धृतराष्ट्रो महाप्राज्ञः पर्यतप्यत् भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said: O king, O descendant of Bharata, after Vidura had gone to the hermitage of the Pandavas, the greatly wise Dhritarashtra repented for his actions.

sa: मयि संनिहिते द्रोणे भीष्मे त्वयि च भारत। अनयो दैवविहितो न कथंचिद् भविष्यति॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, when Drona, Bhishma, you and I will be near at hand, no evil, can possible happen, even if Fate has ordained it.

sa: दमयन्त्युवाच मां चेदिच्छसि जीवन्ती मातः सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते। नलस्य नरवीरस्य यतस्वानयने पुनः॥
en: Damayanti said : O mother! should you desire me to live, I tell the truth, take care to bring here that hero among men, viz., Nala.

sa: तं तथा तप्यमानं तु तपस्तीव्र महामुनिम्। उपेत्य बलभिद् देवो वारयामास वै पुनः॥
en: The slayer of Bala, the deity (Indra) again came to that great Rishi who was engaged in that great austerity and forbade him to do it.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच किमिदं भवति त्वं मां तिष्ठेत्युक्त्वा वराङ्गने। उपरोधं कृतवती न विसर्जितवत्यसि॥
en: The Brahmana said : O the most excellent of women, what was this, that you requested me to wait and that you have not dismissed me?

sa: संस्थाप्य तामाश्रमदर्शने तु संतारितां नावमथातिशुभ्राम्। नीरादुपादाय तथैव चक्रे नाव्याश्रमं नाम वनं विचित्रम्॥
en: Taking the exceedingly white vessel from the water and placing it within the sight of the hermitage, she then made a beautiful forest, named “Floating Hermitage.”

sa: नानृजुर्नाकृतात्मा च नाविद्यो न च पापकृत्। स्नाति तीर्थेषु कौरव्य न च वक्रमतिर्नरः॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, men, who are crooked-minded, who have not souls under control, who are illiterate and who are sinful, do not bathe in Tirthas.

sa: स्वपतस्तस्य देवस्य पद्मं सूर्यसमप्रभम्। नाभ्यां विनिःसृतं दिव्यं तत्रोत्पन्नः पितामहः॥ साक्षाल्लोकगुरुर्ब्रह्मा पद्मे सूर्यसमप्रभः।
en: When he (thus) lay asleep, a lotus as beautiful and effulgent as the sun sprang from his navel. From the sun-like effulgent lotus sprang the Grandsire.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं ब्रुवाणं भीमं तुधर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। उवाच सान्त्वयन् राजा मूर्युपाघ्राय पाण्डवम्॥
en: And king Dharmaraja Yudhishthira, having consoled and smelling the crown of the head of that son of Pandu, Bhima, who thus (as above) addressed, spoke thus.

sa: एवं त्वं मामिहाभ्येत्य निकृति यदि मन्यसे। देवनाद् विनिवर्तस्व यदि ते विद्यते भयम्॥
en: If, therefore, in approaching me to play, you consider that I am actuated by dishonest motives, and if you are afraid then desist from the play.

sa: भगवन् क्षुद्रमत्स्योऽस्मि बलवद्भ्यो भयं मम। मत्स्येभ्यो हि ततो मां त्वं त्रातुमर्हसि सुव्रत॥
en: "O exalted one, I am a helpless little fish; I am afraid of the large ones; a vow-observing Rishi, you should extend your protection to me,

sa: कर्शनार्थो हि योधर्मो मित्राणामात्मनस्तथा। व्यसनं नाम तद् राजन् नधर्मः स कुधर्म तत्॥
en: O king, the virtue, that produces affliction on one's ownself and on one's own friends, is no virtue, at all. It is vice that produces calamities.

sa: उत्तङ्क उवाच भवता रक्षणं कार्यं तत् तावत् कर्तुमर्हसि। निरुद्विग्ना वयं राजंस्त्वत्प्रसादाद् भवेमहि॥
en: Uttanka said: O king, your duty is to protect men. You should perform your that duty. Let us be freed from all anxieties through your favour.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कौरवाणां कुलकरं ज्येष्ठं पाण्डवमच्युतम्। इत्युक्तः शकुनिः प्राह जितमित्येव तं नृपम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having been thus addressed, Shakuni thus spoke to the perpetuator of the Kuru race, the eldest Pandava of undeteriorating glory, “Lo, I have whom?"

sa: तदा च पृथिवीपाल यो भवेद्धर्मसंयुतः। अल्पायुः स हि मन्तव्यो न हिधर्मोऽस्ति कश्चन।।५२।
en: O ruler of earth, he who becomes virtuous in such periods does not at all live long. The earth becomes devoid of virtue in every shape.

sa: भृगुस्तस्य जटान्तस्थो बभूव हृषितो भृशम्। न चापि दर्शनं तस्य चकार स भृगुस्तदा।॥
en: Bhrigu, who was living within the matted locks of Agastya, became highly pleased at this act of Nahusha. He took care not to look at Nahusha.

sa: साधुवृत्तो हि यो राजा सवृत्तमनुतिष्ठति। किं न प्राप्तं भवेत् तेन सव्याजेनेह कर्मणा॥
en: That king who is of righteous conduct and who is observant of honesty and integrity, succeeds by his acts of sincerity in acquiring every valuable reward.

sa: ततो विष्टभ्य विपुलो गुरुपल्याः कलेवरम्। उवास रक्षणे युक्तो न च सा तमबुद्ध्यता॥
en: Restraining every part of the lady's body, Vipula continued to live within her, intent on protecting her from Indra. The lady herself knew nothing of this.

sa: यतिरुवाच अक्षरं च क्षरं चैव द्वैधीभावोऽयमात्मनः। अक्षरं तत्र सद्भावः स्वभावः क्षर उच्यते॥
en: The Indestructible and the Destructible form the twofold manifestation of the soul. Of these the Indestructible is existent. The Destructible is said to be exceedingly nonexistent.

sa: प्रियं त मे तु मे स्यात् सुमहत्कृतं चक्रगदाधर। श्रीमन् प्रीतेन मनसा सर्वे यादवनन्दन॥ यदि मामनुजानीयाद् भवान् गन्तुं तपोवनम्।
en: And, O holder of the mace and the discus, O scion of Yudhu's race, O glorious one, if (now) do you gladly permit me to retire into the woods, then you would do what is greatly desired by me.

sa: ऋषय ऊचुः को वा स्विदिह धर्माणामनुष्ठेयतमो मतः। व्याहतामिव पश्यामो धर्मस्य विविधां गतिम्॥
en: The Rishis said Which among the duties is considered to be the most worthy of being performed? The various modes of duty, we sec, are contradictory.

sa: अहं हितं वदाम्येतत् प्रियं चेत् तव पार्थिव। देवयाना हि पन्थानः श्रुतास्ते यज्ञसंस्तरे॥
en: I shall, you what is beneficial, if it be agreeable to you, O king. You have while employed in our sacrifices, heard of the celestial paths.

sa: शब्दः स्पर्शस्तथा रूपं त्रिगुणं ज्योतिरुच्यते॥ ज्योतिषश्च गुणो रूपं रूपं च बहुधा स्मृतम्।
en: Sound, touch, and colour, these are the three qualities of light. Colour is the quality of light, and colour is said to be of various sorts.

sa: ततो दानपवित्रेण प्रीतोऽस्मि तपसैव च। पुण्यस्यैव हि ते सत्त्वं पुण्यस्यैव च दर्शनम्॥
en: I am greatly delighted with your very sacred gift as also with your penances. Your power is that of virtue. Your appearance is that of virtue.

sa: जिज्ञासुस्तमृषिश्रेष्ठं किं कुर्याद् विप्रिये कृते। इति संचिन्त्य धर्मः स धर्मयामास तत् पयः॥
en: Indeed, Dharma desirous of determining what that foremost of Rishis would do when seeing some injury done to him. Having thought thus, Dharma spoiled that milk.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच सभायां वसतोस्तत्र निहत्यारीन् महात्मनोः। केशवार्जुनयोः का नु कथा समभवद् द्विज॥
en: Janamejaya said When the great Keshava and Arjuna after killing their enemies went to the assembly rooms what conversation, O twice-born one, took place between them?

sa: नष्टादित्ये तथा लोके तमोभूते नगात्मजे। तृतीयं लोचनं दीप्तं सृष्टं मे रक्षता प्रजाः॥
en: When the universe became sunless and, therefore, all became dark, O daughter of the prince of mountains, I created a third eye for protecting all creatures.

sa: कृपा हि पे सुमहती त्वां दृष्ट्वा तृट्समाश्रितम्। इत्युक्तस्तेन स मुनिस्तत् तोयं नाभ्यनन्दत॥
en: Seeing you afflicted by thirst I have felt great mercy for you! Thus addressed by the hunter, the ascetic showed no inclination to accept that water.

sa: हतपुत्राविमौ वृद्धौ विदित्वा दुःखितौ तथा॥ अनुजानीत भद्रं वो व्रजाव शरणं च वः।
en: Knowing that both of us are old and afflicted and destitute of children, grant us the permission we seck. Blessed be you, we seek your protection.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तास्तु ते तेन पौरजानपदा जनाः। वृद्धेन राज्ञा कौरव्य नष्टसंज्ञा इवाभवन्॥
en: Thus addressed, O you of Kuru's race, by the old king, the citizens and the inhabitants of the provinces stood sometime like men shorn of consciousness.

sa: व्यास उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु राज्ञा स नारदः प्रत्युवाच ह। आविक्षितं महाराज वाचा संजीवयन्निव॥
en: Vyasa said Thus told by that king, Narada, O powerful prince, made this reply to him with words which seemed to revive that son of Avikshit.

sa: केन वृत्तेन राजेन्द्र वर्तमाना नरा भुवि। प्राप्नुवन्त्युत्तमं स्वर्गे कथं च नरकं नृप॥
en: What is that conduct by following which O king, men succeed in acquiring high heaven and what is that conduct by which one sinks in Hell?

sa: अश्वमेधो हि राजेन्द्र पावनः सर्वपाप्मनाम्। तेनेष्ट्वा त्वं विपाप्मा वै भविता नात्र संशयः॥
en: The Horse-Sacrifice, O king, is a purifier of all sins. Forsooth, having adored the deities by that sacrifice you will surely be purged of all sins.

sa: महेश्वर उवाच सारमुद्धृत्य युष्माभिः साधुधर्म उदाहृतः। धर्मगुह्यमिदं मत्तः शृणुध्वं सर्व एव ह॥
en: Maheshvara said You have recited excellent duties from your Inemory. Listen all of you now to me as I declare some mysteries about religion and duty.

sa: तस्मात् कर्मसु नि:स्नेहा ये केचित् पारदर्शिनः। विद्यामयोऽयं पुरुषो न तु कर्ममयः स्मृतः॥
en: Therefore, those whose vision extends to the other end have no attachment to actions. This Purusha, however is full of knowledge and not full of action.

sa: येषामेतानि तिष्ठन्ति गृहेषु गृहमेधिनाम्। तान्यधृष्याण्यगाराणि पिशिताशैः सुदारुणैः॥ लोकानस्मद्विधा ये च विचरन्ति यथासुखम्।
en: Those householders who keeps these things in their houses always find them free from the attacks of even the most dreadful spirit that live on carrion.

sa: कृतकृत्यश्च स तदा शिष्यः कुरुकुलोद्वह। तत् पदं समनुप्राप्तो यत्र गत्वा न शोचति॥
en: Having done all that he should have done, the pupil, O perpetuator of Kuru's race, attained to that seat going where one has not to grieve.

sa: यदा धर्मो ग्लाति वंशे सुराणां तदा कृष्णो जायते मानुषेषु। धर्मे स्थित्वा स तु वै भावितात्मा परांश्च लोकानपरांश्च पाति॥
en: When the cause of Virtue suffers, this Krishna takes birth in the family of either the gods or among men. Staying on Virtuc, this Krishna of purified soul (on such occasions) protects both the higher and the lower worlds.

sa: आत्मजां रूपसम्पन्नां महतीं सदृशे वरे। न प्रयच्छति यः कन्यां तं विद्याद् ब्रह्मघातिनम्॥
en: You should know that man as guilty of Brahmanicide who does not confer upon a suitable bridegroom his daughter endued with beauty and other excellent qualities.

sa: अभिमन्युः प्रियः कृष्ण भ्रातृणां नात्र संशयः। ते श्रुत्वा किं नु वक्ष्यन्ति द्रोणपुत्रास्त्रनिर्जिताः॥
en: Abhimanyu, O Krishna, was, forsooth, the minion of all the Pandava-brother. Hearing this intelligence, what will those heroes, defeated by the weapon of Drona's son say?

sa: अग्नि उवाच गन्धर्वराड् यात्वयं तत्र दूतो बिभेम्यहं वासव तत्र गन्तुम्। संरब्धो मामब्रवीत् तीक्ष्णरोषः संवर्तो वाक्यं चरितब्रह्मचर्यः॥ यद्यागच्छः पुनरेवं कथंचिद् बृहस्पतिं परिदातुं मरुत्ते। दहेयं त्वां चक्षुषा दारुणेन संक्रुद्ध इत्येतदवैहि शक्र॥
en: Agni said Let this king of the Gandharvas go there as your messenger, O Vasava, for I am afraid to go there myself, Know, O Shakra, that highly enraged Samvarta, addicted to ascetic practices, told me these words in anger, 'I shall burn you with my fierce evil eyes if you on any account come again here to present Brihaspati to king Marutta.'

sa: तैः सार्धं नृपतिं वृद्धं ततस्तौ पर्युपासताम्। ततो निशि महाराजो धृतराष्ट्र: कुरूद्वहान्॥ जनार्दनं च मेधावी व्यसर्जयत वै गृहान्। तेऽनुज्ञाता नृपतिना ययुः स्वं स्वं निवेशनम्॥
en: In the company of all those persons, Arjuna and Krishna then approached king Dhritarashtra (again). Night came and then the intelligent king Dhritarashtra dismissed all those perpetuators of Kurus' race as also Janardana for retiring to their respective rooms. Permitted by the king, all of them entered their respective apartments.

sa: ते वैवाहिकानां द्रव्याणां प्रेष्याणां च युधिष्ठिर। दातारो वाससां चैव ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who give away such articles as are necessary in marriages, as also servants and maids, and cloths and robes succeed in ascending to heaven.

sa: कृमिर्जीवति वर्षाणि दश पञ्च च भारत। अधर्मस्य क्षयं कृत्वा ततो जायति मानवः॥
en: Assuming such a form he has to live, O Bharata, for fifteen years. When his sin is exhausted by such suffering, he regains the human form.

sa: व्यतिरिक्तं तमो यत्र तिर्यग् भावगतं भवेत्। अल्पं तत्र रजो ज्ञेयं सत्त्वमल्पतरं तथा॥
en: There where Ignorance exists in increased measure, in the lower creatures (for example), Darkness exists in a smaller measure and Goodness in a still lesser degree.

sa: स भवान् मित्रतामद्य सम्प्राप्तो मम पार्थिव। स मे बुद्धिं प्रयच्छस्व सम्मतां पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: You, again, O king, have become my friend today. Do you then, O foremost of men, give me such advice as is approved by the wise.

sa: तं तु दृष्ट्वा वचः प्राह ब्रह्मा राजन् भगीरथम्। कथं भगीरथागास्त्वमिमं लोकं दुरासदम्॥
en: Seeing this, O monarch, the Grandfather Brahman, addressing Bhagirama, said, How, O Bhagiratha, have you attained to this region that is so hard to get at.

sa: इन्द्रव्रतसहस्रं तु यश्चरेत् कायशोधनम्। पिबेद् यश्चापि गङ्गाम्भः समौ स्यातां न वा समौ॥३९
en: It cannot be said whether, he who performs a thousand Chandrayana rites for purifying his body and he who drinks the water of Ganga, are equal.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच इत्युक्तः य मया शिष्यो मेधावी मधुसूदन। पप्रच्छ पुनरेवेमं मोक्षधर्मं सुदुर्वचम्॥
en: Thus addressed by me, that intelligent disciple, O destroyer of Madhu, once more asked me about this religion of Liberation that is so difficult to explain.

sa: ततो मृगमिवाकाशे यथा देवः पिनाकधृक्। ससार तं तथा वीरो विधिवद् यज्ञियं हयम्॥
en: The heroic Arjuna duly followed that sacrificial horse even as the divine holder of Pinaka had in days of yore followed the deer through the sky.

sa: श्रीः कृत्वेह वपुः कान्तं गोमध्येषु विवेश ह। गावोऽथ विस्मितास्तस्या दृष्ट्वा रूपस्य सम्पदम्॥
en: Once on a time, assuming a very beautiful form, the goddess Shree entered a herd of kine. Sceing her beauty the kine became filled with wonder.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तद् दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्ये पुत्राणां दर्शनं नृप। वीतशोकः स राजर्षिः पुनराश्रममागमत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Seeing that highly wonderful spectacle, : viz., the re-appearance of his children, the royal sage, Dhritarashtra renounced his grief and returned to his hermitage.

sa: गावस्तेजो महद् दिव्यं गवां दानं प्रशस्यते। ये चैताः सम्प्रयच्छन्ति साधवो वीतमत्सराः॥ ते वै सुकृतिनः प्रोक्ताः सर्वदानप्रदाश्च ते। गवां लोकं तथा पुण्यमाप्नुवन्ति च तेऽनघ॥
en: Kine form high and excellent energy. The gift of kine is highly spoken of. Those good men who, shorn or pride, make gifts of kine, are considered as doers of righteous deeds and as givers of all articles. Such men, O sinless one, acquire the highly sacred region of kine.

sa: तत्र गत्वा मया सार्धं पर्युपासन्त तां शुभाम्। अथाहमब्रुवं तत्र देवीं तां तपसान्विताम्॥
en: I then addressed that goddess gifted with penances, and said, O goddess, O you of faultless conduct, for what purpose do you practise such severe austerities,

sa: किं नु वक्ष्यामि मुनिषु कर्म चासत्कृतं प्रभो। कस्मिन्वा कारणे त्यक्ता राघवेण महात्मना॥
en: What reply shall I offer to the ascetics when they shall ask me "Child, why has the highsouled Rāghava renounced you? What sin have you committed?"

sa: एतान् दोषांस्तु कौन्तेयो दृष्टवानिति मे मतिः। अतः प्रसह्य हृतवान् कन्यां धर्मेण पाण्डवः॥
en: I think the son of Kunti (Arjuna) saw these faults in all other methods, therefore the Pandava took the maiden away by force according to ordinance.

sa: तेनार्चिषा सुसंतप्ता देवा: सर्षिपुरोगमाः। ततो जग्मुर्महात्मानः सर्व एव दिवौकसः। शतक्रतुं सहस्राक्षं देवेशमसुरार्दनम्॥
en: Thereupon all the illustrious celestial went in a body to their chief of one hundred sacrifices and one thousands eyes the grinder of the Asuras, Indra.

sa: यां त्वं मां सर्वतो हीनामुत्सृज्यासि गतः पुरा। तामेव लपितां गच्छ तरुणी चारुहासिनीम्॥
en: Go to Lapita of sweet smiles who is endued with beauty and youth and to whom you had gone on seeing me difficult in every thing.

sa: श्रुत्वैतत्प्राह विनेशो यदि मे लेखनी क्षणम्। लिखितो नावतिष्ठेत तदा स्यां लेखको ह्यहम्॥
en: On hearing this Ganesha thus replied; I shall become the writer of your work, provided my pen is not made to stop even for a moment.

sa: त्वरस्व भीम मा क्रीड जहि रक्षो विभीषणम्। पुरा विकुरुते मायां भुजयोः सारमर्पय॥
en: O Bhima, be quick. Do not play (with him); kill the fierce Rakshasas. He can display Maya delusions, hereafter. Therefore, show the strength of you arms.

sa: न त्विदं केषुचिद् ब्रह्मन् व्याहर्तव्यं कथंचन। विद्यार्थिनो हि मे पुत्रान् विप्रकुर्युः कुतूहलात्॥
en: O Brahmana, do not by any means disclose this to anybody; for then people, being curious and desirous of learning (their power), will trouble my sons.

sa: दुपदैषा हि सा जज्ञे सुता वै देवरूपिणी। पञ्चानां विहिता पत्नी कृष्णा पार्षत्यनिन्दिता॥
en: This your daughter of celestial beauty is that maiden. The faultless Krishna of the Prishata race had been pre-ordained to be the wife of five (men).

sa: शौनक उवाच भुजंगमानां शापस्य मात्रा चैव सुतेन च। विनतायास्त्वया प्रोक्तं कारणं सूतनन्दन॥
en: Shaunaka said : O son of Suta, you have told us why the snakes were cursed by their mother; and why Vinata also cursed her son.

sa: सम्यकप्रणीतया नीत्या नाधर्मो विद्यते व चित्। तस्माद्राजभयात्सर्वे रक्षन्तीह परस्परम्॥ बाणा इव मया मुक्ता इह रक्षन्ति मे प्रजाः। तथापि त्वं महाबाहो प्रजा रक्षस्व तत्परः॥
en: Royal policy if properly adopted, impiety can stand nowhere. It is for the fear of the king that people protect one another. And although laws, instituted by the are protecting the subjects like so many arrows, still, O you having long arms, do you be engaged in governing the subjects.”

sa: केयं वै बृहती श्यामा सुकुमारी तवानघ। शेते वनमिदं प्राप्य विश्वस्ता स्वगृहे यथा॥
en: O sinless one, who is this delicate lady of transcendent beauty sleeping so trustfully here in this forest, as if she is in her own house?

sa: तत् ते शापाद् विनिर्मुक्ता आपवस्य महात्मनः। स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि पुत्रं पाहि महाव्रतम्॥
en: Thus have I freed them from the curse of the illustrious Rishi Apava (Vasistha.) Be blessed, I leave you now. Rear this child of rigid vows.

sa: ततः स भगवान् सूर्यो मामुपादाय वीर्यवान्। आगच्छत् तां सभां ब्राह्मीं विपाप्मा विगतक्लमः॥
en: (When I completed my vow), then the illustrious and powerful and sinless Surya who knows no fatigue came and took me to the Sabha of Brahma.

sa: स तु श्वा शरपूर्णास्य: पाण्डवानाजगाम हा तं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवा वीराः परं विस्मयमागताः॥
en: The dog, thus pierced in the mouth with the arrows, came back to the Pandavas and the Pandava heroes on seeing this were very much astonished.

sa: अपापां वेद्मि सीते ते तपोलब्धेन चक्षुषा। विस्रब्धा भव वैदेहि सांप्रतं मयि वर्तसे॥
en: By the eyes of asceticism, I perceive, O daughter of Janaka, that you are innocent. You have come under my shelter, O Vaidehi-to be you consoled.

sa: आदिप्रभृति वै राजन्पञ्चसर्गशतानि च। काण्डानि षट् कृतानीह सोत्तराणि महात्मना ॥ कृतानि गुरुणास्माकमृषिणा चरितं तव। प्रतिष्ठा जीवितं यावत्तावत्सर्वस्य वर्तते॥
en: O king, that high-minded ascetic is our preceptor. He has described your actions in six books beginning with the first consisting of five hundred sections. All good actions performed by you since your birth have been recorded in this.

sa: तदहं प्रज्ञया ज्ञात्वा बलं भीमस्य पाण्डव। प्रतिकार्ये च विप्रस्य ततः कृतवती मतिम्॥
en: O Pandaya, from that day I have come to know the (great) strength of Bhima. Therefore, I am desirous of requiting (the services) of the Brahmana.

sa: भविष्यति झुपायेन यस्य दास्यामि यातनाम्। एकं तु श्रोतुमिच्छामि तद्वृत्तं निर्जने वने।॥ संवादं पन्नगेन्द्रस्य काश्यपस्य च कस्तदा। श्रुतवान्दृष्टवांश्चापि भवत्सु कथमागतम्। श्रुत्वा तस्य विधास्येऽहं पन्नगान्तकरी मतिम्॥
en: I have however, devised a means by which I shall punish him. I now wish to hear how you heard and how you saw what happened in the solitude of the forest, especially the conversation between Takshaka and Kashyapa. Having heard this, I shall devise means for the destruction of the snakes,

sa: धर्मात्मा च महात्मा च दुष्यन्तः पुरुषोत्तमः। अभ्यगच्छः पतिं यत् त्वं भजमानं शकुन्तले॥ महात्मा जनिता लोके पुत्रस्तव महाबलः। य इमां सागरापाङ्गीं कृत्स्नां भोक्ष्यति मेदिनीम्॥
en: The best of men Dushyanta, is virtuousminded and high-souled. O Shakuntala, you have accepted (this Dushyanta) for your husband. The son, whom you will give birth to, will be mighty and illustrious in this world. He will extend his sway over the whole of this earth bounded by the sea.

sa: स कदाचिद् वनं राजा मृगयां निर्ययौ पुरात्। मृगान् विध्यन् वराहांश्च चचार रिपुमर्दनः॥
en: One day the king came out of his capital for the purpose of hunting. That chastiser of foes pierced (with his arrows) many deer and boars.

sa: यथावृत्तं तु तत्सर्वं तक्षकस्य द्विजस्य च। एतत्ते कथितं राजन्यथा दृष्टं श्रुतं च यत्। श्रुत्वा च नृपशार्दूल विधत्स्व यदनन्तरम्॥
en: And told us in detail what happened between Takshaka and the Brahmana. O king, we are thus able to tell you what we saw or heard. O best of kings, having heard it, do what should be done now.

sa: सोऽहं पश्यामि वक्तव्यं त्वयि धर्मभूतां वर। पुत्रत्वं बालता चैव तवावेक्ष्य च साहसम्॥
en: O best of pious men, considering that you are my son and a mere boy and seeing your rashness, I see I must give you advice.

sa: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा महर्षिः समुपागमत्। बालचन्द्रप्रतीकाशौ देवपुत्रौ महौजसौ॥ जगाम तत्र हृष्टात्मा ददर्श च कुमारको। भूतघ्नीं चाकरोत्ताभ्यां रक्षा रक्षोविनाशिनीम्॥
en: Hearing those words the highly effulgent Vālmīki went there and attained to great on beholding those two highly effulgent sons, resembling the newly risen sun and the celestials. Thereupon he made arrangements against the oppression of ghosts and goblins.

sa: लक्षयित्वा निमित्तानि तानि घोराणि सर्वशः। तेऽब्रुवन् ब्राह्मणा राजन् विदुश्च महामतिः॥ यथेमानि निमित्तानि घोराणि मनुजाधिप। उत्थितानि सुते जाते ज्येष्ठे ते पुरुषर्षभ॥ व्यक्तं कुलान्तकरणो भवितैष सुतस्तव। तस्य शान्तिः परित्यागे गुप्तावपनयो महान्॥
en: O king, seeing these frightful ominous signs, the assembled Brahmanas and the high minded Vidura said, “O king, O best of men, when these fearful ominous signs are seen at the birth of your eldest son. It is evident he will be exterminator of your race. The prosperity of the race depends upon his abandonment. There must be great calamity in keeping him.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचो राज्ञः सस्मितं मृदु वल्गु च। वसूनां समयं स्मृत्वाथाभ्यगच्छदनिन्दिता॥ उवाच चैव राज्ञः सा ह्लादयन्ती मनो गिरा। भविष्यामि महीपाल महिषी ते वशानुगा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard these soft and sweet words of the smiling king, that faultless maiden remembered the promise she had made to the Vasus. She spoke to the king, sending a thrill of pleasure; (she said), “O protector of the world, I shall become your wife and obey your commands.

sa: तेन मे बहुशस्तात पिता ते परिकीर्तितः। अर्हः सत्यवतीं वोढुं धर्मज्ञः स नराधिपः॥
en: He has many times recounted to me the great achievements of your father. He has told me that, that virtuous king is worthy of marrying Satyavati.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कचस्तु तं तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रतिजग्राह तद् व्रतम्। आदिष्टं कविपुत्रेण शुक्रेणोशनसा स्वयम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Commanded by the son of Kavi, Ushanas, also called Shukra, Kacha said, “Be it so." And he rook the vow he spoke of.

sa: मम ज्येष्ठेन यदुना नियोगो नानुपालितः। प्रतिकूलः पितुर्यश्च न स पुत्रः सतां मतः॥
en: My commands were disobeyed by my eldest son. The opinion of the wise men is that the son disobeys his father is no son at all.

sa: समीपे ते न वत्स्यामि गमिष्यामि यथागतम्। शक्तिरस्ति न वामोरु मयि सुप्ते विभावसोः॥ अस्तं गन्तुं यथाकालमिति मे हृदि वर्तते। न चाप्यवमतस्येह वासो रोचेत कस्यचित्॥
en: I shall no longer live with you, I shall go away whence I came. O lady of the snake-race, I know it for certain, the Sun has no power to set (at the usual time) if I remain asleep. A man cannot remain in the place where he is insulted,

sa: विज्ञाय दानवेन्द्राणां मयं वै शिल्पिनां वरम्॥ जिघांसुर्वासुदेवस्तं चक्रमुद्यम्य धिष्ठितः। स चक्रमुद्यतं दृष्ट्वा दिधक्षन्तं च पावकम्॥ अभिधावार्जुनेत्येवं मयस्त्राहीति चाब्रवीत्।
en: Seeing the Asura, Vasudeva stood with his weapon upraised, ready to cut him down. Seeing the discus upraised and Agni after him, with the intention of burning him, Maya said "O Arjuna, come soon to me and protect me".

sa: कुशलिनः पुत्रांश्चोत्पादयामासुः। प्रतिविध्यं युधिष्ठिरः, सुतसोमं वृकोदरः, श्रुतकीर्तिमर्जुन:, शतानीकं नकुलः, श्रुतकर्माणं सहदेव इति॥
en: They lived in peace there (in Hastinapur) and begot sons. Yudhishthira begot Prativindhya, Bhima (begot) Sutasoma, Arjuna (begot) Shrutakirti, Nakula (begot) Shatanika and Sahadeva (begot) Shrutakarmana.

sa: तारयस्व च मां गङ्गां दर्शयस्व च तापसान्। ततो मुनिभ्यो वासांसि दास्याम्याभरणानि च॥
en: Do you take me to the other side of the Gangā so that I may behold the ascetics and other confer upon them clothes and ornaments.

sa: ऋषेरङ्गिरस: पौत्रं पुत्रं साक्षाद् बृहस्पतेः। नाम्ना कचमिति ख्यातं शिष्यं गृह्णातु मां भवान्॥
en: “Reverend Sir, accept me as your disciple. I am the grandson of Rishi Angirasa and the son of Brihaspati. I am known as Kacha by naine.

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच ततस्तं क्रोधजं तात और्वोऽग्निं वरुणालये। उत्ससर्ज च चैवाप उपयुङ्क्ते महोदधौ॥
en: Vasishtha said: Thereupon Aurva threw the fire of his wrath into the abode of Varuna (sea) and that fire consumes the waters of the great ocean.

sa: पुरुषत्वं गते शूरे बुधः परमबुद्धिमान्। संवत परमोदारमाजुहाव महायशाः॥ च्यवनं भृगुपुत्रं च मुनिं चारिष्टनेमिनम्। प्रमोदनं मोदकरं ततो दुर्वाससं मुनिम्॥ एतान्सर्वान्समानीय वाक्यज्ञस्तत्त्वदर्शनः। उवाच सर्वान्सुहृदो धैर्येण सुसमाहितान्॥
en: In turn, the heroic Ila, having regained his manhood, the highly illustrious and intelligent Budha, well-informed of birth and well-skilled in the are of speech, sent for the highly liberal Samvarta, Bhrgu's son Cyavana, Aristanemi, the foremost of Munis, Durvasa, capable of affording delight, and other friends gifted with patience and said.

sa: शेते सा भुवि तन्वङ्गी मम शोकविवर्धिनी। बान्धवानां च सर्वेषां किं नु दुःखमत:परम्॥
en: “Alas! The slender-bodied beauty who increases my grief, is now lying on the bare ground. What can be more painful than this to all her friends!

sa: अर्हः पूरुरिदं राज्यं यः सुतः प्रियकृत् तव। वरदानेन शुक्रस्य न शक्यं वक्तुमुत्तरम्॥
en: Therefore, Puru, who has done good to you, deserve, to have the kingdom. As Shukra has granted this boon, we have no power to say anything.

sa: ममैषा भगिनी पार्थ सारणस्य सहोदरा। सुभद्रा नाम भद्रं ते पितुर्मे दयिता सुता। यदि ते वर्तते बुद्धिर्वक्ष्यामि पितरं स्वयम्॥
en: O Partha, she is my sister and also the sister of Sarana. Her name is Subhadra; she is the most beloved daughter of my father. If your mind is set upon her, I shall then speak to my father."

sa: कच्चिन्न लोभान्मोहाद् वा विश्रम्भात् प्रणयेन वा। आश्रितानां मनुष्याणां वृत्तिं त्वं संरुणत्सि वै॥
en: Do you, out of covetousness of folly, deprive of the pensions of the men that have come to you for protection out of trustfulness or love?

sa: एवमुक्तः स कृष्णेन पाण्डवः परवीरहा। जरासंधस्य तद् रूपं ज्ञात्वा चक्रे मतिं वधे॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having been thus addressed by Krishna, and knowing the state of Jarasandha, the Pandava (Bhima), the slayer of hostile heroes, determined to kill him.

sa: अहं हि विश्वकर्मा वै दानवानां महाकविः। सोऽहं वै त्वत्कृते कर्तुं किंचिदिच्छामि पाण्डव॥
en: I am a great artist, (in fact I am) the Vishvakarma of the Danavas. Therefore, O son of Pandu, I desire to do something for you.

sa: कच्चिन्मन्त्रयसे नैकः कच्चिन्न बहुभिः सह। कच्चित् ते मन्त्रितो मन्त्रो न राष्ट्रं परिधावति॥
en: You do not surely settle any thing alone or take advice of many. Counsels received fro the ministers surely do not spread all over your Kingdom.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः शरं समादाय धनुर्दोणो महायशाः॥ शरेण विद्ध्वा मुद्रां तामूर्ध्वमावाहयत् प्रभुः। सशरं समुपादाय कूपादङ्गुलिवेष्टनम्॥ ददौ ततः कुमाराणां विस्मितानामविस्मितः। मुद्रिकामुद्भूतां दृष्ट्वा तमाहुस्ते कुमारकाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Then the greatly illustrious Drona, taking a bow with an arrow pierced the ring with it and brought it up. Raising up from the well that ring, pierced with the arrow, he gave it to the astonished princes. Then princes too, seeing the ring thus recovered, said-

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच ददानीत्येव तं तत्र राजानं प्रत्युवाच ह। वसिष्ठः परमेष्वासं सत्यसंधो द्विजोत्तमः॥
en: The Gandharva said : The best of the twice born, ever devoted to truth Vasishtha, replied to that great bowman, the king saying, “I will give."

sa: यथाहं राघवादन्यं मनसापि न चिन्तये। तथा मे माधवी देवी विवरं दातुमर्हति ॥
en: I have never thought of any other person in my mind but Rāma; by the strength of this virtue let the goddess Vasundharā give me room.

sa: अनुव्रजति कोन्वेष मामित्येवाथ सोऽब्रवीत्। अहमित्यदृश्यन्तीमं सा स्नुषा प्रत्यभाषत। शक्तेर्भार्या महाभाग तपोयुक्ता तपस्विनी॥
en: He said, “Who is it that follows me?" His daughter-in-law replied, “I am Adrishyanti, the wife of Shakti. I am an ascetic woman, engaged in asceticism."

sa: त्वं हि सर्वानवद्याङ्गी सर्वाभरणभूषिता। विभूषणमिवैतेषां भूषणानामभीप्सितम्॥ न देवी नासुरां चैव न यक्षी न च राक्षसीम्। न च भोगवतीं मन्ये न गन्धर्वी न मानुषीम्॥
en: You are perfectly faultless in your every feature; decked in every ornament, you seem to be the coveted ornament of those ornaments themselves. You seem to be not a Devi or an Asuri, or a Lakshmi, or a Rakshasi; you are not a Nagini or a Gandharvi or a Manushi.

sa: तं च पापं न जानीमो यदि दग्धः पुरोचनः। कथं तु विप्रमुच्येम भयादस्मादलक्षिताः॥
en: We do not know whether the sinful Purochana has or has not been burnt to death. How shall we escape from the dangers unobserved by others!

sa: उवाच चैनं भगवान् रुरुः संशमयन्निव। कामं मां भुजग ब्रूहि कोऽसीमां विक्रियां गतः॥
en: Then Ruru, the possessor of six attributes, cheering up the snake, said to it, “Who are you, tell me, O snake, that have been thus metamorphosed?”

sa: अष्टक उवाच यदा तु तान् वितुदन्ते वयांसि तथा गृध्राः शितिकण्ठाः पतङ्गाः। कथं भवन्ति कथमाभवन्ति न भौममन्यं नरकं शृणोमि॥
en: Ashtaka said: When life is destroyed by age, vultures, Shitikantha, insects and worms eat up the human body, where does man then live? How does he come to life again? I have never heard of any hell called Bhauma.

sa: प्रीतोऽस्मि तव राजेन्द्र विक्रमेण बलेन च। न ते विघ्नं करिष्यामि प्रतिज्ञां समपालयम्॥
en: "O foremost of kings, I have been pleased with your strength and prowess. I shall not do you any wrong. I have fulfilled the (Kshatriya) vow.

sa: यद्यपि स्वेन रूपेण चरिष्यथ महीमिमाम्। न वो विज्ञास्यते कश्चित् त्रिषु लोकेषु भारत॥
en: "O Bharata, even if you wander in the world in your own proper shapes, no one in the three worlds shall be able to recognize you.

sa: ब्राह्मणं ब्राह्मणो वेद भर्ता वेद स्त्रियं तथा। अमात्यं नृपतिर्वेद राजा राजानमेव च॥
en: A Brahmana knows a Brahmana in the same way as the nusband knows the wife. A king knows his minister and a monarch knows a monarch.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच प्रीतोऽस्मि वो निवर्तध्वं वरान् वृणुत पुत्रकाः। यद् यदिष्टमृते त्वेकममरत्वं तथास्तु तत्॥
en: Brahma said: I am pleased with you, desist, O sons and pray for boons; all your desires, with the exception of immortality only, will be fulfilled.

sa: कण्व उवाच मातलिस्तु व्रजन् मार्गे नारदेन महर्षिणा। वरुणं गच्छता द्रष्टुं समागच्छद् यदृच्छया॥
en: Kanya said While Matali was proceeding on his way he came across the great Rishi Narada who was proceeding, of his own will, to see Varuna.

sa: सर्वं भवतु ते राज्यं पञ्च ग्रामान् विसर्जय। अवश्यं भरणीया हि पितुस्ते राजसत्तम॥
en: Let the entire kingdom be yours but give up only five villages; for surely they ought to be supported be your father, O best of kings.

sa: सुदुष्करं कृतं राजन् निर्जने वसता त्वया। भ्रातृभिः सह राजेन्द्र कृष्णया चानया सह।॥
en: 0 king, great difficulties have been overcome by yourself residing in the forest, in the company, O chief of kings, of your brothers and this lady.

sa: अहो नाहमिदं कर्म कष्टं दुश्चरितं कृतम्। स्वयं दुर्बुद्धिना मोहाद् येन प्राप्तोऽस्मि संशयम्॥
en: Alas, led by folly I have done a highly improper and wicked act, for which, fool that I am, I have now fallen into such distress.

sa: अपश्यं त्वां यदा कृष्णे कीचकेन पदा हताम्। तदैवाहं चिकीर्षामि मत्स्यानां कदनं महत्॥
en: O Krishna, when I saw you kicked by Kichaka, I intended the very moment to bring about a great devastation of the whole of the Matsya's.

sa: एतदेवं विजानन् वै न दास्यामि शचीमिमाम्। इन्द्राणी विश्रुतां लोके शक्रस्य महिषीं प्रियाम्॥
en: Knowing it to be so, I shall not give up this Sachi, the queen of Indra, known in this world as the beloved queen of Shakra.

sa: अश्वत्थामा यथा मह्यं तथा श्वेतहयो मम। बहुना किं प्रलापेन यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः॥
en: What Ashvathama is to me, so is he with white horses (Arjuna); what is the necessity of talking much; where there is virtue there is victory.

sa: यः समुत्पतितं हर्ष दैन्यं वा न नियच्छति। स नश्यति श्रियं प्राप्य पात्रमाममिवाम्भसि॥
en: Like an unburnt earthen vessel in water, he, who is incapable of controlling sudden occasions of joy or grief, is lost even if he obtains prosperity.

sa: सुधन्वोवाच यद् धर्ममवृणीथास्त्वं न कामादनृतं वदीः। पुनर्ददामि ते पुत्रं तस्मात् प्रह्लाद दुर्लभम्॥
en: Sudhanvan said you have chosen virtue and have not I spoken an untruth from temptation; therefore I give back your dear son his life, O Prahrada.

sa: आहरेदपि वित्तानि परेषां क्रोशतामपि। न तिष्ठति स्म सन्मार्गे न च धर्मं बुभूषति॥
en: He extorts money from others, even if they cry in woe; he never stays in paths of rectitude nor does he even feel inclined to virtue.

sa: ईदृशं वचनं ब्रूयाद् भवती पुत्रमेकजम्। किं नु ते मामपश्यन्त्याः पृथिव्या अपि सर्वया॥
en: Such cruel words are spoken by you to your only son; if cease to see me of what good is even the entire earth to you?

sa: प्रसूत्यन्ते प्रसूत्यन्ते कन्यैव त्वं भविष्यसि। स त्वं ददस्व मां राज्ञे प्रतिगृह्य हयोत्तमान्॥
en: That after giving birth to each child I shall again be a virgin; therefore do you offer me to this king accepting these best of horses.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच एकान्तं रथमास्थाय पद्भ्यां त्वमवपीडयन्। दृढं च रश्मीन् संयच्छ शङ्खध्मास्याम्यहं पुनः॥
en: Arjuna said Stand you firmly on this chariot, pressing your feet on it. Get hold lightly of the reins for I will blow the conch again.

sa: आगतौ स्वः पथा येन पलान्यवचितानि च। यथागतं शुभे गच्छ पन्थानं मा विचारय॥
en: We have now reached the path we came by for gathering fruits. O auspicious girl, go along the way we took (in the morning) without hesitation.

sa: सावित्री त्वाह भर्तारं नैकस्त्वं गन्तुमर्हसि। सह त्वया गमिष्यामि न हि त्वां हातुमुत्सहे॥
en: (Thereupon) Savitri said to her husband "you should not go alone. I will go with you. I do not feel inclined to be separated from you.

sa: सनत्सुजात उवाच येषां व्रतेऽथ विस्पर्धा बले बलवतामिव। ते ब्राह्मणा इतः प्रेत्य ब्रह्मलोकप्रकाशकाः॥
en: Sanat-Sujata said These Brahmanas, who are proud of their austerities like powerful men of strength, on their exit from the world shine in the eternal regions.

sa: वर्मन्यन्वेष्यमाणा वै रथिनां रथिसत्तम। न हि विद्मो गतिं तेषां वासं हि नरसत्तम॥
en: O foremost of car-warriors, we pursued (also) the track of those car-warriors, but O foremost of men, we have not found out their whereabouts and movements.

sa: सेना पञ्चशतं नागा रथास्तावन्त एव च। दश सेना च पृतना पृतना दशवाहिनी॥
en: A consisted of five hundred elephants, and the same number of elephants (with infantry and cavalry); ten Senas made a Pritana and ten Pritanas a Vahini.

sa: जले निमग्नां गां दृष्ट्वा चोद्धर्तुं मनसेच्छति। किं नु रूपमहं कृत्वा सलिलादुद्धरे महीम्॥
en: Beholding the earth submerged in water he made up his mind to rescue it (He thought) "Assuming what form shall I rescue the earth from water?"

sa: यत् त्वद्य मे व्यवसितं तच्छृणुध्वं नरर्षभाः॥ इह प्रायमुपासिष्ये यूयं व्रजत वै गृहान्।
en: O foremost of men, listen to me now as to what I intend to do. I shall stay here fasting, all of you go back home.

sa: प्रशाधा पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां ततस्त्वं भ्रातृभिः सह। समालिङ्ग्य च हर्षेण नृपा यान्तु परस्परम्॥
en: Rule this earth united together with your brothers and let the rulers of men return to their, kingdoms after embracing one another (in a friendly way)

sa: भीमसेन उवाच ये पुरा विचरन्तीह पुरुषा वशवर्तिनः। तस्यास्ते वचनं श्रुत्वा ह्यनृणा विहरन्त्वतः॥
en: Bhima said Hearing these words of hers under which those persons were till then living in that city, they will now live there freed from debt.

sa: न च भीष्मो न च द्रोणो युक्तं तत्राहतुर्वचः। सर्वे तमनुवर्तन्ते ऋते विदुरमच्युत॥
en: In that case neither Bhishma nor Drona said anything-in fact all follow him more or less save Vidura, O you who never swerve from your duties.

sa: अभिगच्छाव सुग्रीवं शैलस्थं हरिपुङ्गवम्। मयि शिष्ये च भृत्ये च सहाये च समाश्वस॥
en: Let us go to Sugriva, the foremost of monkeys who dwells in (yonder) mountain. Cheer yourself up since I, your disciple servant and assistant, am near."

sa: दृष्ट्वैव चैनं तु विचारयाम्यह गन्धर्वराजो यदि वा पुरंदरः। जानीत कोऽयं मम दर्शने स्थितो यदीप्सितं तल्लभतां च मा चिरम्॥
en: Beholding him I do not deem it worth while to discuss whether he is the king of the Gandharvas or Purandara himself; ascertain who it is standing before my eyes, let him have in no time what he desires.

sa: कण्व उवाच मातलिस्तस्य सम्मानं कर्तुमर्हो भवानपि। स तु दीनः प्रहृष्टश्च प्राह नारदमार्यकः॥
en: And it is proper that you should greet Matali with due honors. He (Aryaka) too being sorry and delighted at the same time said to Narada,

sa: बहूनि च नृशंसानि कृतानीन्द्रेण वै पुरा। वैधाण्युपधाश्चैव स वः किं न निवारितः॥
en: In bygone days, many were the deeds of cruelty done by Indra, as also vicious deeds and deceitful ones. Why was he not prevented by you.

sa: विदेहराजो जनकः सीता तस्यात्मजा विभो। यां चकार स्वयं त्वष्टा रामस्य महिषीं प्रियाम्॥
en: O lord, Janaka was the king of Videha and his daughter was Sita. Tvashtri himself created her wishing to make her the beloved queen of Rama.

sa: सुदेष्णां प्रत्युपस्थास्ये राजभार्यां यशस्विनीम्। सा रक्षिष्यति मां प्राप्तां मा भूत् ते दुःखमीदृशम्।।२१
en: I shall serve Shudeshna the reputed wife, of the king, and getting me, she will keep me. Let this anxiety of yours be set at rest.

sa: प्राप्ता द्वारवती सूता विना पार्थः परंतप। न तत्र कृष्णा राजेन्द्र पाण्डवाश्च महाव्रताः॥
en: O slayer of enemies, the charioteers reached, Dvaravati without the son of Pritha. O king, there is neither Krishna nor are the Pandavas of great vows.

sa: कर्ण उवाच एवमप्यस्तु भगवन्नेकवीरवधे मम। अमोघां देहि मे शक्तिं यथा हन्यां प्रतापिनम्॥
en: Karna said: Notwithstanding it is so, O adorable one, give me an infallible dart, destructive of a heroic person, wherewith I can kill a mighty (foe).

sa: आशां नार्हसि मे हन्तुं सौहृदात् प्रणतस्य च। अभितश्चागतं प्रेम्णा प्रत्याख्यातुं न मार्हसि॥
en: You should not dishearten me since I have saluted you through friendship. As I have come here actuated by love, you ought not to refuse me.

sa: विराट उवाच यद्येष राजा कौरव्यः कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। कतमोऽस्यार्जुनो भ्राता भीमश्च कतमो बली॥
en: Virata said If this be the king of Kurus, Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, who, amongst those is his brother Arjuna and who the powerful Bhima?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच प्रविश्याथ गृहं तस्याश्चरणावभिवाद्य च। आचख्यौ तत् समासेन यद् वृत्तं कुरुसंसदि॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then having entered her abode and saluted her feet he described in brief to her what had happened in that assembly of the Kurus.

sa: दुपद उवाच एवमेतन्महाबाहो भविष्यति न संशयः। न हि दुर्योधनो राज्यं मधुरेण प्रदास्यति॥
en: Drupada said O you with long arms, it will doubtless turn out as you have said. Duryodhana will not give back the kingdom by peaceful means.

sa: कर्णस्य च महाबाहो सूतपुत्रस्य दुर्मतेः॥ न चापि पादभाक् कर्णः पाण्डवानां नृपोत्तम। धनुर्वेद च शौर्ये च धर्मे वा धर्मवत्सल॥
en: And also that of the wicked-minded son of the Suta, Karna. O foremost of kings, O lover of virtue, whether in the science of arms or heroisrm or morality, Karna is not (even) the fourth part of the Pandavas.

sa: ततस्ते दक्षिणं तीरमन्वगच्छन् पदातयः। निवृत्तवनवासा हि स्वराष्ट्र प्रेप्सवस्तदा। वसन्तो गिरिदुर्गेषु वनदुर्गेषु धन्विनः॥
en: Then they desirous of regaining their own kingdom put an end to their forest-life and walked on foot to the southern bank of the river (Kalindi).

sa: सम्पन्नं गोषु सम्भाव्यं सम्भाव्यं ब्राह्मणे तपः। सम्भाव्यं चापलं स्त्रीषु सम्भाव्यं ज्ञातितो भयम्॥
en: Milk is possible in cows, devotion is possible in the Brahmanas; unsteadiness is possible among women; and cause of fear may be expected from blood relations.

sa: यच्चापि परमं दिव्यं तच्चाप्यनुगतं त्वया। विधानं विहितं पार्थ कथं शर्म भवेत् परैः॥
en: The one prime object, that has been ordained in Heaven, is known to you. How then can your advice of peace with the enemy be followed?

sa: पुरुषं तं न पश्यामि यः सहेत महाव्रतम्। धृष्टद्युम्नमृते राजनिति मे धीयते मतिः॥
en: That man I do not see who can withstand that one of great vows (Bhishma) save and except Dhrishtadyumna, o king; and such is my opinion.

sa: चिन्तयित्वा तु पार्थेभ्यः प्रेषयिष्यामि संजयम्। स भवान् प्रति यात्वद्य पाण्डवानेव मा चिरम्॥
en: After mature deliberation, shall I send Sanjaya to the sons of Pritha, therefore do you go back at once this day to the sons of Pandu.

sa: परं क्षिपति दोषेण वर्तमानः स्वयं तथा। यश्च क्रुध्यत्यनीशानः स च मूढतमो नरः॥
en: That man is the worst of fools who throws the blame on others, though himself is to blame and who is though unable to do anything.

sa: न चेद् विजित्य गास्तास्त्वं गृहान् वै प्रतियास्यसि। प्रहसिष्यन्ति वीरास्त्वां नरा नार्यश्च संगताः॥
en: If you, without defeating them and taking back your kine, return home, all men and women, O hero, when they will meet, will laugh at you.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शकुनेस्तु वचः श्रुत्वा दुःशासनमवेक्ष्य च।॥ पादयोः पतितं वीरं विकृतं भ्रातृसौहृदम्। बाहुभ्यां साधुजाताभ्यां दुःशासनमरिंदमम्॥ उत्थाप्य सम्परिष्वज्य प्रीत्याजिघ्नत मूर्धनि।
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard the words of Shakuni and having seen Dushashana lying at the feet of the king (Duryodhana) unmanned by fraternal affection, the king raised Dushashana and clasping him in his well formed arms he smelt his head.

sa: भीमस्य च महानादं नदतः शुष्मिणो रणे। श्रुत्वा स्मर्तासि मे वाक्यं गाण्डीवस्य च निः स्वनम् यद्येतदपसव्यं ते वचो मम भविष्यति॥
en: As also by the loud and frequent roars of Bhima in battle. Hearing also the twang of the Gandiva bow you will remember our words and if all this is not followed by you, what we say will come to pass.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु कर्णेन कर्णं राजाब्रवीत् पुनः। न किंचिद् दुर्लभं तस्य यस्य त्वं पुरुषर्षभ॥ सहायश्चानुरक्तश्च मदर्थं च समुद्यतः। अभिप्रायस्तु मे कश्चित् तं वै शृणु यथातथम्॥
en: Having been thus addressed by Karna, the king again thus spoke to him, “O foremost of men, nothing is unattainable to him who has you as a protector and to whom you are attached and on whose welfare you are entirely intent. Now I shall speak to you something which you should listen to.

sa: कोटिकास्यवचः श्रुत्वा शैब्यं सौवीरकोऽब्रवीत्। यदा वाचं व्याहरन्त्यामस्यां मे रमते मनः॥ सीमन्तिनीनां मुख्यायां विनिवृत्तः कथं भवान्। एतां दृष्ट्वा स्त्रियो मेऽन्या यथा शाखामृगस्त्रियः॥ प्रतिभान्ति महाबाहो सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते। दर्शनादेव हि मनस्तया मेऽपहृतं भृशम्॥ तां समाचक्ष्व कल्याणी यदि स्याच्छैव्य मानुषी।
en: Hearing the words of Kotikasya, the Sauvira hero said to Shaivya, "Hearing her words my mind has been inclined towards her. Why have you come unsuccessful from that best of females; having once seen this lady other women appear to me as so many monkeys. O mighty-armed heroes, I tell you the truth. From the very moment I saw her my mind has been entirely captivated by her. Tell me, O Shaivya, if that excellent lady is a human being."

sa: प्रतीयू रथिनो नागा नागांश्च रथिनो ययुः। हयारोहान् रथारोहा रथिनश्चापि सादिनः॥ सादिनश्च हयान् राजन् रथिनश्च महारणे। हस्त्यारोहान् हयारोहा रथिनः सादिनस्तथा॥
en: Elephants rushed against car-warrior and car-warrior proceeded against elephants. Horse-soldiers rushed against horse-soldiers, and car-warrior also advanced towards horsesoldiers. Horse-soldiers, O king, also rushed against horses and elephants in that dreadful fight; also, o king, elephant-riders proceeded against elephant-riders and cavalry.

sa: ये त सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः। अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते॥ तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात्। भवामि नचिरात् पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम्॥
en: I, without delay, become deliver from the ocean of this world of those, who, reposing all actions on Me and considering Me the highest object of attainment, worship Me, mediating on Me with exclusive devotion, and fixing their minds on Me.

sa: यस्यैष दक्षिणे पार्श्वे शुद्धजाम्बूनदप्रभः। विशालक्षास्ताम्राक्षो नीलकुश्चितमूर्धजः॥ एषो हि लक्ष्मणो नाम भ्रातुः प्रियहिते रतः। नये युद्धे च कुशलः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः॥ अमर्षी दुर्जयो जेता विक्रान्तश्च जयी बली। रामस्य दक्षिणो बाहुनित्यं प्राणो बहिश्चरः॥ नह्येष राघरस्यार्थे जीवितं परिरक्षति। एषैवाशंसते युद्धे निहन्तुं सर्वराक्षसान्॥
en: On his right side is one of the splendour of pure gold, broad breasted, having dark curied hair-this one is named Laksmana, ever mindful of his brother's welfare. He is versed in polity as well as warfare-the foremost of those learned in all the branches of knowledge; wrathful, invincible, victorious, powerful, conquering and strong, the right arm of Rāma and his own life going about. For Rāghava he care not for his life. He hope to exterminate all the Rākşasas in battle.

sa: ब्रह्मन्प्रतिबलः शीघ्रं वने फलकृताशनः। चिन्वन्मधूनि मुख्यानि चिन्वन्पुष्पाण्यनेकशः॥ दिने दिने च सायाह्ने ब्रह्मणोऽन्तिकमागमत्। गृहीत्वा राम मुख्यानि पुष्पाणि च फलानि च॥ ब्रह्मणो देवदेवस्य पादमूले न्यवेदयत्। एवं तस्य गतः कालो बहु पर्यटतो गिरिम्॥ कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य समतीतस्य राघव। ऋक्षराड् वानरश्रेष्ठस्तृषया परिपीडितः॥ उत्तरं मेरुशिखरं गतस्तत्र च दृष्टवान्। नानाविहगसंघुष्टं प्रसन्नसलिलं सरः॥
en: There living on fruits and collecting honey and various flowers, he, every day, used to come to Brahmă in the evening. O Rāma, in this wise he used to make an offering of an excellent fruits and flowers at the feet of Brahmā, the god of gods. Journeying in this way over the mountain he spent many long years. Some time having elapsed in this way, O Raghava, Rksaraja, the foremost of monkeys, being distressed with thirst, repaired to the excellent mountain Meru. There is a pond of pure water, resonant with the notes of various birds.

sa: तेषामेवं ब्रुवाणानां वानराणां च रक्षसाम्। हनूमान्प्रणतो भूत्वा राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ स्नेहो मे परमो राजंस्त्वयि तिष्ठतु नित्यदा। भक्तिश्च नियता वीर भावो नान्यत्र गच्छतु॥ यावद्रामकथा वीर चरिष्यति महीतले। तावच्छरीरे वत्स्यन्तु प्राणा मम न संशयः॥
en: The monkeys and Rakşasas having said this, Hanuman bowing, said to Rama "May my loving reverence be always in you, O king; may my devotion to you remain unshaken, O hero; and may my mind be not attached to any other thing. May my life remain in my body as long as the stories of Rama shall be in currency on earth. Let not this prove otherwise.

sa: ग्रीवा तस्याभवद्देवी वीणा चापि सरस्वती। नास्त्यौ श्रवणे चोभौ नेत्रे च शशिभास्करौ॥ वेदाङ्गानि च यज्ञाच तारारूपाणि यानि च। सुवृत्तानि च वाक्यानि तेजांसि च तपांसि च॥ एतानि नररूपस्य तस्य देहाश्रितानि वै। तेन वज्रप्रहारेण लब्धमात्रेण लीलया।॥ पाणिना पीडितं रक्षो निपपात महीतले। पतितं राक्षसं ज्ञात्वा विद्राव्य स निशाचरान्॥ ऋग्वेदप्रतिमः सोऽथ पद्ममालाविभूषितः। प्रविवेश च पातालं निजं पर्वतसंनिभः॥ उत्थाय च दशग्रीव आहूय सचिवान्स्वयम्। क्व गतः सहसा बूत प्रहस्तशुकसारणाः॥ एवमुक्ता रावणेन राक्षसास्ते तदाब्रुवन
en: Sarasvati, the goddess of speech, is his neck, the two Asvins are his ears, the sun and the moon are his two eyes. O Rāma, all the divisions of the Vedas, Aagamas, the whole host of stars, good words, energy, asceticism, all these are being supported by his body, assuming the shape of a man.
